title: Azusawa Kohane — A Secret Between Us〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sorry about making you all take a detour before the night show.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I felt that I should say “hi” to Emu and the others since we're here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you sure you don't want to see them, Haruka, An?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd feel bad about taking up time before the start of their big show.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure we'll get another chance to see them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...
Then, Kohane and I are gonna go talk to them for a bit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, have fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... Do you see any of them?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I guess they really are busy. Maybe it wasn't such a good idea to do this just before their show's about to start...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! Kohane! Minori!
You came to see us?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Emu! I'm so glad we found you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, I wanted to thank you guys for helping us out when we were getting ready for the Fan Festival. Do you have some time to talk?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa! Nene! Rui!
Kohane and Minori came to see us☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, well met, you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, it's been a while!
Thank you so much for the way you helped me out during the Fan Festival!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that? It was nothing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're both in the business of spreading hope and making others smile. It's only natural for us to lend each other a hand since we work so hard every day!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. What a windbag.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, anyway.
Are you two staying for the night show?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We heard that it uses all of PXL as a stage, so we're both really excited!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You are?! Hehe. That means we have to make it extra fun this time♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we should... Why don't we send Tsukasa flying a little higher than usual as a special surprise?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That won't be necessary.
Also, there's no scene in this show involving that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: More importantly, don't forget to get a bracelet from one of the staff.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's for the climax, right?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. You get a signal during the show to raise it in the air.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
We made things even more fun recently by adding in some lucky bracelets♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Lucky bracelets?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, what do you think she means by “lucky”...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You'll just have to wait and find out♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, we'll be looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “No...! Master...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“The lights went out...
The horses and the flying rides...
They've all just stopped...!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Shao...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa... All the lights are going dim...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is what PXL looks like when it's completely dark? It's like everything that was fun and happy here just vanished...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm getting goosebumps from how well it goes with Shao's story.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is unbelievable... It's literally using all of PXL as its stage...

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line:
“Wait, no...
This is no time to be crying...”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “If what Master said is true, that means I can...! No, we can...!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Everyone...!! Can you hear me?!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
We can hear you, Shao!

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Everyone, please! Lend me your energy!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “This was the last thing Master told me! Everybody here can use magic because you're all smiling, laughing and making this such a happy place...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “I can't do this alone! I'm not as good at using magic like Master was, so please, lend me your energy...!!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Lend me your smiles, your joy, your magic...!!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's our signal!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright!
We're gonna give you everything we have, Shao!

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line: Whoa, her bracelet's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Visitor B
rows.Line: Oh wow! It's a rainbow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Wh-Wh-What's going on?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, Minori... Isn't that one of the “lucky bracelets” Otori was talking about?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, it totally is! I mean, you're the only rainbow one around here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Minori!
Oh, I should take a photo of it!

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Alright, let's use your magical smiles to bring light back to this place!”

rows.Speaker: Shao
rows.Line: “Wave!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori, try pointing your bracelet at some trees or buildings like Emu's doing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay! I'll try...!
Wave!

rows.Speaker: Visitor A
rows.Line:
Whoa, the lights!
They're gorgeous...

rows.Speaker: Visitor B
rows.Line: Hey, I think we can do it too...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! This is so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Minori, turn this way!
And strike a pose!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's a great expression!
Alright, one more...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Wave! Huh...?
Mommy, it's not working.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, that's too bad...
We must not have enough magic.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Would you like to keep trying with me? Here, we can do it together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, money shot...!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Girl
rows.Line: Wave!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Wow, we lit them all up!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Kohane's so enamored in taking pictures.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
She and her dad like photography.
Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane's dad apparently likes taking pictures of her more than anything else...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can see why. She's just like Minori in terms of being capable of so many facial expressions...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right?! I totally get how her dad feels.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't we take some as well?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, great idea!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...? A-An, Haruka?!
Were you taking photos of me?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, busted!
No, wait. This just means we should be taking more!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, An! This is so embarrassing!
